properties.description: Halfway between an archive and an alchemy lab, this place is crowded with information. How much use it is to anyone is debatable.
The imposing corridor seems carved out of whole stone. You might believe you were inside a mountain if not for the windows revealing the blackness of the Void.
The warmth of ovens and the smell of food makes this a welcoming place. There's always someone here, though they might be too focused on food to speak with you.
Hidden behind a stack of crates, you can tell this passage was deliberately hidden. Judging by the carpet of cobwebs and dust in this otherwise very neat place, it has been that way for some time.

This must be where the facility grows all its food and components. The air is humid, and you're initially tricked into thinking sunlight filters down from the ceiling, but it's just more alchemical lights.
The corridor is a sharp contrast to the rest of the facility, with plaster walls and wooden framing. A variety of doors to different dormitories line the walls.
This is the facility's entrance. Hallways split off in two directions, going deeper in. The heavy portal door to the outside is currently sealed shut with a magic you can't identify.
There is nothing to see off the edge of the balcony but the infinite blackness of the Void. The area has been decorated nicely, though, with plants and an abundance of lanterns.
